scope_note: Architecture-level engineering crosswalk for BN-024-00A. Entries describe inspected source at the pinned revision; 'proposed_rust' is a design intent, not implemented code. Reuse classification follows the BN-024-00 gate: Apache-2.0 source may be studied and re-implemented; verbatim copying still requires approved_reuse.
pipeline_template: command/API selection (same yml: command list, textfsm template, or structured/json path)
raw output capture (node.py service queue -> output entries)
extraction (TextFSM template / Genie schema / svcparser.py nested-JSON normalizer)
schema/key/default processing (Avro schema *.avsc + sqobjects field defaults)

modules.role: device detection, transport, command dispatch, output envelope
key_functions: _parse_device_type_hostname (show version -> devtype/version; junos-evo vs junos split)
_create_result / _post_result (output envelope: hostname, devtype, version, timestamp, command, data)
modules.nos_coverage: generic dispatch; per-NOS node subclasses selected by devtype string
modules.identity_notes: version field flows into service defn selection; devtype selects cleaner
modules.error_handling: _create_error envelope; exceptions surfaced via service stats
modules.upstream_tests: tests/unit + integration nossim per-NOS dirs (eos iosxe iosxr mx nxos panos qfx)
modules.known_limitations: version '0.0.0' sentinel skips versioned defns; hostname-based normalizer override can shadow devtype (service.py::_get_device_normalizer checks hostname FIRST)
modules.proposed_rust: bonsai platform_registry + typed capture envelope; detection results feed ProfileQuery.release, never silently default
modules.intended_deviations: no hostname-first normalizer shadowing; unknown version stays unknown, never 'all'-fallback for constrained profiles

modules.role: service framework: defn selection, extraction dispatch, merge, clean, diff, commit
key_functions: merge_results (join multi-command outputs on service keys)
modules.nos_coverage: all; per-NOS behavior lives in subclass cleaners + yml defns
modules.identity_notes: merge on service 'keys' (e.g. interfaces.ifname); vrf scoping added by subclass cleaners
modules.units_notes: speed normalization per-NOS in cleaners (EOS bandwidth, NXOS fix_nxos_speed, missing-speed sentinels)
modules.defaults_notes: normalize DSL supports 'field?|default' (e.g. mtu?|0, ipAddressList?|[]) — silent defaults are upstream semantics Bonsai must treat as claims, not truth
modules.error_handling: per-command failures isolated in stats; missing defn -> service skipped
modules.known_limitations: first-match version selection (defn list order); 'all' matches unknown versions; hostname override precedes devtype
modules.proposed_rust: BN-024-05 normalizer pipeline: defn-equivalent = FeatureFlag+typed extractors; keep first-match rule only where version evidence exists
modules.intended_deviations: unknown/unparseable version never selects 'all'; defaults recorded as defaulted fields, not observed values

modules.role: nested JSON -> flat record normalizer driven by 'normalize' templates in config yml
key_functions: eval_expr / num_eval (bounded expression evaluation for computed fields)
modules.nos_coverage: used wherever yml 'normalize' templates exist (eos multi-command merges shown in interfaces.yml)
modules.identity_notes: list-index wildcards 'vlanToVniMap/*' fan out to records
modules.defaults_notes: ?|default syntax; missing keys yield defaults silently
modules.error_handling: template eval errors propagate to service failure path
modules.known_limitations: eval_expr is upstream code execution — Bonsai must NOT port eval; implement closed-form field mappings only
modules.proposed_rust: typed extraction specs in nos_features FeatureFlag.parsers + future BN-024-05 DSL; no eval
modules.intended_deviations: no arbitrary expression eval; every default explicit in typed fact quality.missing_fields

modules.role: interface operational state normalization (first native-feature candidate)
key_functions: _clean_eos_data / _clean_cumulus_data / _clean_junos_data / _clean_nxos_data / _clean_iosxr_data / _clean_iosxe_data+_clean_ios_data (both delegate to _clean_iosxr_data here — opposite direction from bgp.py) / _clean_sonic_data (uses _entry_cumulus_sonic_cleaner + internal_ifnames list, NOT the linux cleaner) / _clean_linux_data (flags-based admin state) / _clean_panos_data
modules.nos_coverage: eos cumulus junos nxos iosxr iosxe sonic panos linux
modules.identity_notes: ifname key + vrf assignment; sonic/cumulus share namespace-aware cleaner but host vs ASIC namespace semantics NOT modeled upstream
modules.units_notes: speed arrives in mixed units per NOS; cleaners normalize to kbps-ish schema field; missing speed sentinels handled explicitly
modules.defaults_notes: mtu default 0 via normalize DSL; burnedInAddress fallback to macaddr; linux cleaner maps state 'unknown' -> 'up' (loopback assumption — unsafe for Bonsai)
modules.error_handling: unknown speed -> explicit missing handling, not fabricated
modules.known_limitations: SONiC ASIC namespace collapse; speed unit inference per-vendor fragile
modules.proposed_rust: first native vertical slice candidate: canonical scoped interface identity + admin/oper state + MTU + speed-with-units + typed unknowns
modules.intended_deviations: namespace-aware identity from day one; speed carries explicit unit field; unknown != down

modules.role: BGP neighbor/AFI-SAFI normalization with heavy per-vendor cleaning
modules.nos_coverage: eos junos nxos iosxr ios iosxe cumulus linux sonic panos
modules.identity_notes: neighbor keyed by address+vrf; Cumulus expansion multiplines records per AFI/SAFI
modules.units_notes: prefix counters numeric; state strings vendor-specific
modules.defaults_notes: bfdStatus missing/'unknown' -> 'disabled' (unsafe default Bonsai should NOT copy — unknown BFD must stay unknown); acceptedPrefixCounter default 0
modules.error_handling: non-Established neighbors skipped entirely upstream — Bonsai must represent them explicitly
modules.known_limitations: unknown->disabled BFD default; non-established dropped; SONiC inherits Linux cleaner losing ASIC/namespace context
modules.proposed_rust: later slice; per-AFI/SAFI record expansion is the model to reuse conceptually
modules.intended_deviations: unknown BFD stays unknown; non-established neighbors are facts, not omissions

modules.role: route table normalization; protocol token -> canonical protocol mapping
key_functions: proto_map lookup: entry['protocol'] = proto_map.get(entry['protocol'][0], ...)[0] — FIRST CHARACTER ONLY
modules.nos_coverage: all via per-NOS yml + common cleaner
modules.identity_notes: prefix+vrf+nexthop identity; 47 raw SuzieQ route records dedup to 40 join keys in differential corpus
modules.units_notes: preference/metric ints; uptime parsed from statusChangeTimestamp
modules.defaults_notes: missing vrf -> 'default'; protocol[0] silently truncates flags like 'S*' -> 'S' -> 'static'
modules.error_handling: unmapped protocol first-char falls back to raw token
modules.known_limitations: protocol flag characters ('*' candidate default, '%' override) are LOST upstream — SuzieQ itself drops them; Bonsai may intentionally preserve as separate flag field
modules.proposed_rust: route facts preserve protocol AND flags separately; proto_map-equivalent is versioned data
modules.intended_deviations: preserve candidate-default/override flags upstream discards; no first-char truncation

modules.role: running-config capture: raw text -> single 'config' record with crude secret filtering
key_functions: get_diff (Python hash() of whole config string -> add/del)
modules.nos_coverage: generic raw-text path; NOT a multi-NOS effective-config compiler
modules.identity_notes: single record per device; no statement structure
modules.defaults_notes: regex secret filter is best-effort and lossy (drops any matching line incl. non-secret context)
modules.known_limitations: no ordering/hierarchy/semantics preserved; hash() is process-seeded (PYTHONHASHSEED) — diff unstable across runs; confirms owner assessment that upstream is not a config compiler
modules.proposed_rust: BN-024-10..13 Batfish-inspired seam: ordered AST -> effective config; ConfigStore::summarize_diff line-set limitation tracked under BN-024-12A/19
modules.intended_deviations: lossless capture with redaction boundaries + source spans; semantic diff replaces line-set/hash diff

modules.role: per-service per-NOS command/extraction/version predicates + Avro schemas
key_observations: apply.<nos>.version: 'all' or version predicate list; copy:<other_nos> aliases (sonic copies cumulus in interfaces.yml)
normalize templates drive svcparser nested extraction incl. multi-command merges (eos interfaces: show interfaces + show vrf + show ip virtual-router)
schema keys/defaults live in *.avsc; sqobjects add query/assertion layer
modules.license_class: study_and_reimplement (Apache-2.0); templates/assets per-asset approved_reuse still pending
